title: Personal-Data Leakage from Prompt Injection Replicated on Self-Hosted Agents

original_idea.body: # Personal-Data Leakage from Prompt Injection Replicated on Self-Hosted Agents

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: PII leakage is real-world harm but the link to catastrophic AI risk is more near-term privacy.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: synthetic data + injection scenarios + leak measurement, beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: fixed scenarios, per-model leak rate, clear success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: self-hosted agents labs do not benchmark, synthetic data only.

novelty.reasoning: Attack published; open self-hosted-model replication may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Open self-hosted-agent leak rates likely uncharacterized.
